mistake_content: The test method test_03_verify_the_position_of_the_buttons_on_the_cancel_shortcut_creation_pop_up_window_C48 is missing its proper docstring with TestRail URL. Currently, it only has a comment '# LOCAL MISTAKE: Missing docstring with TestRail URL' instead of the required triple-quoted docstring format that follows the HPX automation framework convention.
solution:
Add a proper triple-quoted docstring immediately after the method definition line. The docstring must contain the test description followed by the TestRail URL link. Replace the comment '# LOCAL MISTAKE: Missing docstring with TestRail URL' with the following docstring:

        """
        Verify the buttons of cancel shortcut creation pop up window.
        TestRails -> https://hp-testrail.external.hp.com/index.php?/cases/view/48
        """

This follows the standard HPX automation framework convention where all test methods must have a docstring with:
1. A clear description of what the test verifies (ending with a period)
2. A blank line
3. The TestRail reference in the format: 'TestRails -> [URL]'

This convention is consistently applied across all test methods in the HPX rebranding test suite (as seen in test_01, test_02, test_04, test_05, and test_06 in the same file) and is required for proper test documentation and traceability to TestRail test cases.

mistake_content: Test method 'test_04_verify_the_screen_when_the_user_clicks_on_go_back_button' is missing the TestRail ID suffix '_C49'
solution:
According to Section 7.1 STANDARD TEST FILE STRUCTURE and Section 20 NAMING CONVENTIONS & MARKERS of the HPX QE QAMA Scripting Best Practice Knowledge Base, all test methods MUST follow the naming convention:

test_XX_<description>_C<testrail_id>

The TestRail ID suffix is MANDATORY for test traceability and reporting. The docstring indicates this test corresponds to TestRail case C49.

CORRECTION REQUIRED:
Rename the test method from:
  def test_04_verify_the_screen_when_the_user_clicks_on_go_back_button(self):
To:
  def test_04_verify_the_screen_when_the_user_clicks_on_go_back_button_C49(self):

This ensures proper integration with TestRail tracking system and maintains consistency with the framework's naming standards as seen in other test methods in the same file (e.g., test_01_..._C46, test_02_..._C47, test_03_..._C48).
